selectedProcesses.descendantClaim: SOURCE selected composition only; original boot mounts public services, never runProfile/install/browser. Empty tools/preset and no migration. Original native flock reads the installed prebuilt addon in-process. No runtime descendant observation has occurred. Any unexpected descendant/alive group is BLOCKED/HOLD for root-owned cleanup.

wrapperPopen.environmentBoundary: Only two explicit synthetic variables are supplied to the new Node process before any JS. HOME/NODE_OPTIONS/NODE_PATH/proxy/credential variables are never inherited or inspected. Original launch snapshot contains exactly the same two fixture values.

selectedProcesses.signals: one common sticky stop; actual owned identity must be observed and rechecked; at most one child-PID-directed SIGTERM request; denial/unknown forbids any further signal; zero force/terminating group signals

readOnlyOwnedIdentityObservations.terminalGroupProbe: only signal0 on the already observed original owned group; absent/present/NOT_OBSERVED; no terminating group signal

runnerCapture.allSetupCaptureDrainTeardownFinalMainRep: closed finite code; no raw traceback; one reporter attempt; missing verdict/HOLD if reporter unavailable
runnerCapture.EOFAndGroup: leader exit plus both EOFs plus observed owned group ABSENT required for local process success; escaped descendants remain NOT_OBSERVED

time.NodeOrigin: process.uptime includes inert imports and preflight; timers never reset
time.runnerResult: still-alive child/group => BLOCKED/HOLD; never success/release; root-owned cleanup required
time.additivePerCallDeadline: FORBIDDEN: every attempt additionally checks shared global abort, work expiry aborts fixture HTTP and starts original disposal
time.phaseWaits: boot30s/ordinary5s/execute75s ceilings clipped to remaining135s Node work; copied provider60s unchanged. Pre-position85s and pre-P23 recheck admit75s carrier+10s conditional tail. Cleanup15s clipped to remaining150s. No TTL/grant/clock extension.
time.slowPositionWrite: exclusive marker remains consumed if recheck refuses transport; no refund/retry/fsync/power-loss promise

physicalIO.streamOverflow: truncate retention, request one graceful stop, CLOSED HOLD; never forward content
originalTransients: credential exclusive lock and one random atomic sibling

retainedRuntimeInventory.read: one final metadata-only traversal below sole new private-run after final observation and outcome writes; no private payload export
retainedRuntimeInventory.enforcement: observation/refusal only. Not physical write/syscall counting, an intercepted prewrite quota or a disk guarantee; preserve original transients and unknown durable state.

physicalIO.additionalControlledNodeOutcomeMode: 0600 wx; sole known new observations path; no retry on write failure
physicalIO.streamAccounting: hash/count accepted retained prefix separately from received-at-least bytes; EOF/completeness and known/unknown truncation are explicit; close failure remains HOLD; no raw stream forwarding

cleanup.localExpiration: Node requests public cleanup first; pending disposal at 150s self-exit records UNKNOWN and writes no original terminal/release. Runner does not claim remote/cloud termination.
cleanup.retention: scratch, credentials, setup/store/session and new once markers retained; no rm/reset/rollback of native unknowns

publicOutput: closed schemas: refs/digests/booleans/finite counts/enums; private cookies/URLs/headers/keys/context/model/raw errors never forwarded or copied to observations

verdict.exactMarker: full trimmed genuine public/native result only; no truncation/rewrite
verdict.overallSuccess: Node exit0 + original sequence observed + PASS + public cleanup + strict controlled outcome + leader exit/both EOF/group absent; not release, billing, cold/browser/all87/final CODE acceptance
